cards.name: Corphish

attacks.name: Sharp Pincers
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.

cards.name: Doduo

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Doduo does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

cards.name: Drifloon

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: Drifloon does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a "Signpost for Wandering Spirits."

cards.name: Feebas

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Count and Draw
attacks.text: Draw a card for each of your opponent's Pokémon that isn't an Evolved Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

cards.name: Geodude

attacks.name: Focus Fist
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.

cards.name: Gible

attacks.name: Sand Attack
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.

cards.name: Goldeen

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Goldeen.

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Though it appears very elegant when swimming with fins unfurled, it can jab powerfully with its horn.

cards.name: Growlithe

attacks.name: Fireworks
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to Growlithe.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

cards.name: Kricketot
cards.flavorText: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

cards.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Flail Around
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

cards.name: Magnemite

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The faster the units at its sides rotate, the greater the magnetic force they generate.

cards.name: Mankey

attacks.name: Extra Punch
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Pokémon LV.X, this attack does 10 damage plus 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

cards.name: Meditite

attacks.name: Karate Chop
attacks.text: Does 30 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on Meditite.

cards.flavorText: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.

cards.name: Meowth

attacks.name: Double Kick
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

cards.name: Mime Jr.

abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Mr. Mime from your hand onto Mime Jr. (this counts as evolving Mime Jr.) and remove all damage counters from Mime Jr.

attacks.name: Encore
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can use only that attack during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It mimics the expressions and motions of those it sees to understand the feelings of others.

cards.name: Mudkip

attacks.name: Mud Sport
attacks.text: If Mudkip has less Energy attached to it than the Defending Pokémon, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

cards.name: Nincada

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Dash Attack
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

cards.name: Pachirisu

attacks.name: Pachi
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

cards.name: Paras

attacks.name: Spore
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

cards.name: Rhyhorn

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its powerful tackles can destroy anything. However, it is too slow witted to help people work.

cards.name: Roselia

attacks.name: Spit Poison
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: The more healthy the Roselia, the more pleasant its flowers' aroma. Its scent deeply relaxes people.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.flavorText: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

cards.name: Seel

attacks.name: Icy Wind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

cards.name: Shroomish

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

cards.name: Skorupi

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Tail Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: As soon as the tail claws close, its needle tips secrete poison. It can survive a year without food.

cards.name: Starly
cards.flavorText: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

cards.name: Surskit

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

cards.name: Turtwig

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell should feel moist.

cards.name: Whismur

attacks.name: Tone-Deaf
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.

cards.name: Zubat

attacks.name: Quick Turn
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It checks its surroundings and location using reflections of the ultrasonic waves from its mouth.

cards.name: Battle Tower
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.
Whenever any player plays any Pokémon from his or her hand to Level-Up 1 of his or her Pokémon, remove 4 damage counters from that Pokémon.

cards.name: Champion's Room
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.
The Retreat cost for each Pokémon SP (both yours and your opponent's) is Colorless less.

cards.name: Cynthia's Guidance
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Look at the top 7 cards of your deck, choose 1 of them, and put it into your hand. Put the other cards back on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Cyrus's Initiative
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Flip 2 coins. If either of them is heads, look at your opponent's hand. For each heads, choose 1 card from your opponent's hand and put it on the bottom of your opponent's deck in any order.

cards.name: Night Teleporter
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, put all cards in your hand on top of your deck. Then, search your deck for any 1 card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Palmer's Contribution
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Search your discard pile for up to 5 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

cards.name: VS Seeker
rules: Search your discard pile for a Supporter card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand.

cards.name: Absol G LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Absol G. Absol G LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

abilities.name: Darkness Send
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you put Absol G LV.X from your hand onto your Active Absol G, you may flip 3 coins. For each heads, put the top card from your opponent's deck in the Lost Zone.

attacks.name: Darkness Slugger
attacks.text: You may discard a card from your hand. If you do, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.name: Blaziken FB LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Blaziken FB. Blaziken FB LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

abilities.name: Burning Spirit
abilities.text: Any damage done by attacks to a Burned Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) is increased by 40 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). No more than 40 damage can be added by all Burning Spirit Poké-Bodies.

attacks.name: Jet Shoot
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Blaziken FB by attacks is increased by 40 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Charizard G LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Charizard G. Charizard G LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

abilities.name: Call for Power
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move an Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to Charizard G. This power can't be used if Charizard G is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Malevolent Fire
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard all Energy attached to Charizard G.

cards.name: Electivire FB LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Electivire FB. Electivire FB LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

abilities.name: Energy Recycle
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this power. If you do, your turn ends. Search your discard pile for up to 3 Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. This power can't be used if Electivire FB is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Powerful Spark
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Garchomp C LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Garchomp C. Garchomp C LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

abilities.name: Healing Breath
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you put Garchomp C LV.X from your hand onto your Active Garchomp C, you may remove all damage counters from each of your Pokémon SP.

attacks.name: Dragon Rush
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy attached to Garchomp C. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Garchomp C can't use Dragon Rush during your next turn.

cards.name: Rayquaza C LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Rayquaza C. Rayquaza C LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

abilities.name: Dragon Spirit
abilities.text: If Rayquaza C is your Active Pokémon and is damaged but not Knocked Out by an opponent's attack, you may search your discard pile for an Energy card and attach it to Rayquaza C.

attacks.name: Final Blowup
attacks.text: Discard all Energy attached to Rayquaza C. Ignore this effect if you have no cards in your hand.

cards.name: Staraptor FB LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Staraptor FB. Staraptor FB LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

abilities.name: Fast Call
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Supporter card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Staraptor FB is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Defog
attacks.text: Before doing damage, you may discard any Stadium card in play. If you do, this attack's base damage is 70 instead of 40.

cards.name: Articuno

attacks.name: Diamond Dust
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon is said to freeze the water in the air during winter, causing snow.

cards.name: Moltres

attacks.name: Hyper Flame
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard a Fire Energy attached to Moltres. If tails, discard all Energy attached to Moltres.

cards.flavorText: The flames on this legendary Pokémon's wings burn so brightly that they can make night seem like day.

cards.name: Zapdos

attacks.name: Lightning Burn
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) If tails, Zapdos does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon is said to be present wherever there is a lightning storm.

cards.name: Milotic

abilities.name: Aqua Mirage
abilities.text: If you have no cards in your hand, prevent all damage done to Milotic by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dwindling Wave
attacks.text: Does 80 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on Milotic.

cards.flavorText: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

cards.name: Relicanth

attacks.name: Deep Sea Pressure
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's Retreat Cost is ColorlessColorless more.

attacks.name: Aqua Wave
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

cards.name: Yanma

attacks.name: Sonicboom
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Baton Pass
attacks.text: You may switch Yanma with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, move as many Energy cards attached to Yanma as you like to the new Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It can hover in one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.

abilities.name: Fire Formation
abilities.text: Each of Charizard's attacks does 10 more damage for each Fire Pokémon on your Bench to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Burning Tail
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy attached to Charizard.

cards.name: Froslass

abilities.name: Snow Gift
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Froslass from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may search your deck for any 1 card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Ground Frost
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium Card in play, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

cards.name: Heatran

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Magma Mantle
attacks.text: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. This attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage for each Fire or Metal Energy card you discarded.

cards.flavorText: Its body is made of rugged steel. However, it is partially melted in spots because of its own heat.

cards.name: Kabutops

attacks.name: Primal Scythe
attacks.text: You may discard Helix Fossil, Dome Fossil, or Old Amber from your hand. If you do, this attack does 20 damage plus 50 more damage.

attacks.name: Rock Slide
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.

cards.name: Luxray

attacks.name: Flash
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Gadget Bolt
attacks.text: If Luxray has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, you may do 100 damage instead of 60 to the Defending Pokémon. If you do, discard that Pokémon Tool card.

cards.flavorText: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

cards.name: Mothim

attacks.name: Cloak Party
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of Burmy and Wormadam, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Energy Assist
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for a basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: While it loves floral honey, it won't gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from Combee.

abilities.name: Competitiveness
abilities.text: If you don't have a Supporter card in play, each of Probopass's attacks does 30 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Top Chop
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Tumbling Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 damage plus 30 more damage.

abilities.name: Top Accelerator
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a basic Energy card, attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. If that card isn't a basic Energy card, discard it. This power can't be used if Salamence is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Shoot Through
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Swalot

attacks.name: Damage Roller
attacks.text: Put damage counters on the Defending Pokémon until the Defending Pokémon has the same remaining HP as Swalot. (If the Defending Pokémon has the same or less remaining HP as Swalot, this attack does nothing.)

attacks.name: Entangle Tackle
attacks.text: You may do 50 damage plus 30 more damage. If you do, this attack does 30 damage to 1 of your Pokémon, and don't apply Weakness and Resistance to this damage.

cards.flavorText: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.

cards.name: Tangrowth

attacks.name: Leaf Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Tangrowth by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Swallow Up
attacks.text: Before doing damage, count the remaining HP of the Defending Pokémon and Tangrowth. If the Defending Pokémon has fewer remaining HP than Tangrowth's, this attack does 120 damage instead.

cards.flavorText: Its arms are made of plants that bind themselves to things. They grow back right away if cut.

cards.name: Toxicroak

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Convert Blow
attacks.text: If Toxicroak has any Psychic Energy attached to it, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. If Toxicroak has any Fighting Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for more potency.

attacks.name: Charge Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your discard pile for an Energy card and attach it to Zapdos G.

attacks.name: Lightning Strike
attacks.text: You may discard all Lightning attached to Zapdos G. If you do, this attack's base damage is 80 instead of 40.

cards.name: Aerodactyl

abilities.name: Unearth
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for Helix Fossil, Dome Fossil, or Old Amber, show it your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Aerodactyl is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

cards.name: Bronzong

attacks.name: Oracle Arrow
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Antigravity
attacks.text: The Retreat Cost for Bronzong is 0 until the end of your next turn.

cards.flavorText: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

cards.name: Cherrim

abilities.name: Cloudy Sky
abilities.text: If any of your Grass Pokémon or Fire Pokémon would be damaged by an attack, reduce that damage by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Worry Seed
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun's rays with its whole body.

cards.name: Gengar

abilities.name: Curse
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of your opponent's Pokémon. This power can't be used if Gengar is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Shadow Skip
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) You may switch Gengar with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.

cards.name: Gengar

attacks.name: Sharpshooting
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.

cards.name: Glalie

attacks.name: Wreck
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 20 damage plus 50 more damage. Discard that Stadium card.

attacks.name: Avalanche
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.

attacks.name: Tumble Down
attacks.text: Discard as many Fighting Energy cards as you like from your hand. The attack does 30 damage times the number of Fighting Energy cards you discarded.

attacks.name: Rock Tumble
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.name: Hariyama

attacks.name: Push Out
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Vortex Chop
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Resistance, this attack's base damage is 120 instead of 60.

cards.flavorText: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.

cards.name: Lopunny

abilities.name: Relaxing Shower
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard an Energy card from your hand. If you do, remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon. This power can't be used if Lopunny is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hover Heal
attacks.text: Remove all Special Conditions from Lopunny.

cards.flavorText: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.

cards.name: Manectric

attacks.name: Second Bite
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Omastar

attacks.name: Time Spiral
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Evolved Pokémon. Remove the highest Stage Evolution card from that Pokémon and have your opponent shuffle that card into his or her deck.

attacks.name: Primal Tentacles
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each Helix Fossil, Dome Fossil, and Old Amber in your discard pile.

cards.flavorText: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.

cards.name: Pelipper

attacks.name: Water Pulse
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Continuous Crush
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

cards.name: Pichu

abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Pikachu from your hand onto Pichu (this counts as evolving Pichu) and remove all damage counters from Pichu.

attacks.name: Baby Steps
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck, choose 1 of them, and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

cards.flavorText: The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.

abilities.name: Dowsing Code
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Porygon-Z G from your hand onto your Bench, you may search your discard pile for up to 2 Pokémon Tool cards, show them to your opponent, and shuffle them into your deck.

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 40 more damage.

cards.name: Raichu

attacks.name: Boosted Voltage
attacks.text: If Raichu has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that isn't an Evolved Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Thunder Blast
attacks.text: Discard a Lightning Energy card attached to Raichu.

cards.flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

abilities.name: Wild Guard
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Rapidash by your opponent's Pokémon SP.

attacks.name: Rising Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.name: Raticate

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

cards.name: Hitmontop

attacks.name: Triple Kick
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Close Combat
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Hitmontop by attacks is increased by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

cards.name: Jumpluff

attacks.name: Mass Attack
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Leaf Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Jumpluff by attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores—it can even float around the world.

cards.name: Ninetales

abilities.name: Roast Reveal
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Fire Energy card from your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards. This power can't be used if Ninetales is affected by a Special Condition.

cards.flavorText: Its nine beautiful tails are filled with a wondrous energy that could keep it alive for 1,000 years.

cards.name: Noctowl

abilities.name: Night Sight
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may draw a card. This power can't be used if Noctowl is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Extrasensory
attacks.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 40 damage plus 40 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

cards.name: Quagsire

attacks.name: Muddy Water
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

cards.name: Raichu

attacks.name: Iron Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy attached to Raichu.

cards.flavorText: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

cards.name: Shuckle

abilities.name: Shell Barricade
abilities.text: As long as Shuckle is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to Shuckle by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: The berries it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

cards.name: Slowking

abilities.name: Second Sight
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at the top 3 cards of that player's deck and put them back on top of that player's deck in any order. This power can't be used if Slowking is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Psyshock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

cards.name: Wobbuffet

attacks.name: Double Return
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage times the number of damage counters on Wobbuffet.

cards.flavorText: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

cards.name: Ampharos

attacks.name: Acceleration Bolt
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Ampharos does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

cards.name: Ariados

attacks.name: Leech Life
attacks.text: Remove from Ariados the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poisonous Saliva
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It's hard to tell which end is which.

cards.name: Butterfree

attacks.name: Cure Powder
attacks.text: Remove 3 damage counters from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Water-repellent powder on its wings enables it to collect honey, even in the heaviest of rains.

cards.name: Cleffa

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Cleffa is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Cleffa by attacks.

attacks.name: Eeeeeeek
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw 6 cards. Cleffa is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Exeggutor

attacks.name: Energy Absorption
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for up to 2 Energy cards and attach them to Exeggutor.

attacks.name: Big Eggsplosion
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to Exeggutor. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: If a head drops off, it emits a telepathic call in search of others to form an Exeggcute cluster.

cards.name: Farfetch'd

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Spin Turn
attacks.text: Switch Farfetch'd with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: If it eats the plant stalk it carries as emergency rations, it runs off in search of a new stalk.

cards.name: Feraligatr

attacks.name: Spinning Tail
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

cards.name: Furret

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Quick Blow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

cards.name: Granbull

attacks.name: Timid Tackle
attacks.text: Granbull does 20 damage to itself. Switch Granbull with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Chomp
attacks.text: Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Granbull.

cards.flavorText: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its bite is powerful.

cards.name: Hypno

abilities.name: Sleep Pendulum
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. This power can't be used if Hypno is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Psychic Shot
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

cards.name: Lapras

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Ice Blade
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.

cards.name: Ledian

attacks.name: Quick Draw
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The spot patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.

cards.name: Meganium

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Giant Bloom
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from Meganium.

cards.flavorText: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

cards.name: Persian

attacks.name: Sharpen Claws
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, discard a card from your opponent's hand without looking.

attacks.name: Sneaky Attack
attacks.text: If Persian has any Darkness Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

cards.name: Pichu

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Pichu is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Pichu by attacks.

attacks.name: Playground
attacks.text: Each player may search his or her deck for as many Basic Pokémon as he or she likes, put them onto his or her Bench, and shuffle his or her deck afterward. (You put your Pokémon on the Bench first.) Pichu is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

cards.name: Sandslash

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: If it digs at an incredible pace, it may snap off its spike and claws. They grow back in a day.

cards.name: Smoochum

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Smoochum is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Smoochum by attacks.

attacks.name: Energy Antics
attacks.text: Move an Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of your opponent's Pokémon. Smoochum is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

cards.name: Sunflora

abilities.name: Sunshine Grace
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Grass Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Sunflora is affected by a Special Condition.

cards.flavorText: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

cards.name: Typhlosion

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy attached to Typhlosion.

cards.flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

cards.name: Tyrogue

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Tyrogue is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Tyrogue by attacks.

attacks.name: Mischievous Punch
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. Tyrogue is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Even though it is small, it can't be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

cards.name: Weezing

attacks.name: Super Poison Breath
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Super Explosion
attacks.text: Weezing does 90 damage to itself, and don't apply Weakness to this damage.

cards.flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

cards.name: Bayleef
cards.flavorText: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

cards.name: Blissey

attacks.name: Energy Link
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for an Energy card and attach it to Blissey.

attacks.name: Double-edge
attacks.text: Blissey does 40 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Anyone who takes even one taste of Blissey's egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

cards.name: Corsola

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard a Water Energy attached to Corsola and remove all damage counters from Corsola.

attacks.name: Hyper Cannon
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

cards.name: Croconaw

attacks.name: Big Bite
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

cards.name: Delibird

attacks.name: Snowy Present
attacks.text: Draw a card for each Water Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hail
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.

cards.name: Donphan

attacks.name: Rock Hurl
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Double Spin
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

cards.name: Dunsparce

attacks.name: Glare
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Fade Out
attacks.text: Return Dunsparce and all cards attached to it to your hand.

cards.flavorText: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

cards.name: Flaaffy

attacks.name: Thunder Spear
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

cards.name: Heracross

attacks.name: Green Draw
attacks.text: Draw a card for each of your Grass Pokémon in play.

attacks.name: Double Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

cards.name: Igglybuff

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Igglybuff is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Igglybuff by attacks.

attacks.name: Graffiti
attacks.text: Igglybuff is now Asleep. During your opponent's next turn, the attack cost of each of the Defending Pokémon's attacks is Colorless more.

cards.flavorText: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously—anytime, anywhere.

cards.name: Mantine

attacks.name: Group Swim
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Water Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Aqua Slash
attacks.text: Mantine can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if Remoraid attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.

cards.name: Metapod

abilities.name: Green Shield
abilities.text: Each of your Grass Pokémon has no Weakness.

cards.flavorText: It prepares for evolution by hardening its shell as much as possible to protect its soft body.

cards.name: Miltank

attacks.name: Moomoo Squeeze
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Moomoo Milk card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: If it is around babies, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

cards.name: Parasect

attacks.name: Sleep Drain
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. Remove 4 damage counters from Parasect.

cards.flavorText: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mushroom spores it scatters.

cards.name: Quilava

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to Quilava.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

cards.name: Qwilfish

attacks.name: Offensive Needle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

cards.name: Skiploom

attacks.name: Knock Away
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

cards.name: Slowbro

attacks.name: Big Yawn
attacks.text: Both Slowbro and the Defending Pokémon are now Asleep.

attacks.name: Madkinesis
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each Psychic Energy attached to Slowbro.

cards.flavorText: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, it reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

cards.name: Starmie

attacks.name: Cosmic Cyclone
attacks.text: Choose as many Water Energy attached to your Pokémon as you like. This attack does 20 damage times the number of Energy you chose. Shuffle those cards back into your deck.

cards.flavorText: The middle section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.

cards.name: Unown

abilities.name: RETURN
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Unown from your hand onto your Bench, you may return all Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to your hand.

cards.flavorText: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Unown

abilities.name: FLASH
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Unown from your hand onto your Bench, you may look at the top 5 cards of your deck and put them back on top of your deck in any order.

cards.flavorText: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

cards.name: Wigglytuff

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Expand
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Wigglytuff by attacks is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a Body Slam.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: Its feet have suction cups designed to stick to any surface. It tenaciously climbs trees to forage.

cards.name: Chansey

attacks.name: Happy Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove 3 damage counters from Chansey.

cards.flavorText: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.flavorText: Its pleasantly aromatic leaf has the ability to check the humidity and temperature.

cards.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Minimize
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Clefairy by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.flavorText: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

cards.name: Drowzee

attacks.name: Sleep Inducer
attacks.text: Switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. The new Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.

cards.name: Exeggcute

attacks.name: Continuous Eggsplosion
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Using telepathy only they can employ, they always form a cluster of six Exeggcute.

cards.name: Girafarig

attacks.name: Show Off
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

cards.name: Hoothoot

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

cards.name: Hoppip

attacks.name: Bounce
attacks.text: You may switch Hoppip with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. But they do enjoy gentle breezes.

cards.name: Jigglypuff

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Looking into its cute, round eyes causes it to sing a relaxing melody, inducing its enemies to sleep.

cards.name: Jynx

attacks.name: Mimic
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw a number of cards equal to the number of cards in your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Lick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.

cards.name: Koffing

attacks.name: Smokescreen
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.

cards.name: Ledyba

attacks.name: Comet Punch
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: When the weather turns cold, lots of Ledyba gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: For no reason, it jumps and splashes about, making it easy for predators like Pidgeotto to catch it mid-jump.

cards.name: Mareep

attacks.name: Static Electricity
attacks.text: Search your deck for a number of Lightning Energy cards up to the number of Mareep in play (both yours and your opponent's) and attach them to Mareep. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

cards.name: Marill

attacks.name: Water Splash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

cards.name: Meowth

attacks.name: Pay Day
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: It loves anything that shines. It especially adores coins that it picks up and secretly hoards.

cards.name: Paras

attacks.name: Double-edge Claw
attacks.text: Paras does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: As its body grows large, large mushrooms named tochukaso start sprouting out of its back.

cards.name: Phanpy

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Phanpy.

cards.flavorText: It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

cards.name: Sandshrew

attacks.name: Defense Curl
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Sandshrew by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Disliking water, it lives in deep burrows in arid areas. It can roll itself instantly into a ball.

cards.name: Sentret

attacks.name: Scout
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

cards.name: Slowpoke

attacks.name: Whimsy Tackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

cards.name: Snubbull

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

cards.name: Spinarak

attacks.name: Spider Web
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: At night, the center of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.

cards.name: Sunkern

attacks.name: Cure Kernels
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a Spearow, it will violently shake its leaves.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.flavorText: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.

cards.name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to Vulpix.

cards.flavorText: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.

cards.name: Wooper

attacks.name: Tail Whip
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

cards.name: Bill
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Copycat
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw a number of cards equal to the number of cards in your opponent's hand.

cards.name: Energy Switch
rules: Move a basic Energy card attached 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Fisherman
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Search your discard pile for 4 basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand.

cards.name: Full Heal
rules: Remove all Special Conditions from your Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Moomoo Milk
rules: Choose 1 of your Pokémon. Flip 2 coins. For each heads, remove 3 damage counters from that Pokémon.

cards.name: Poké Ball
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Pokégear 3.0
rules: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. Choose a Supporter card you find there, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

cards.name: Pokémon Collector
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Pokémon Communication
rules: Choose 1 Pokémon in your hand, show it to your opponent, and put it on top of your deck. If you do, search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Pokémon Reversal
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon, and switch it with your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Professor Elm's Training Method
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Search your deck for an Evolution card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Professor Oak's New Theory
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards.

cards.name: Switch
rules: Switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Double Colorless Energy
rules: Double Colorless Energy provides ColorlessColorless Energy.

cards.name: Rainbow Energy
rules: Attach Rainbow Energy to 1 of your Pokémon. While in play, Rainbow Energy provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.) When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon. (While not in play, Rainbow Energy counts as Colorless Energy.)

abilities.name: Conductivity
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from his or her hand to 1 of his or her Pokémon, put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Lightning Crush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 40 more damage. If tails, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

abilities.name: Blissful Nurse
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Blissey from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may remove all damage counters from all of your Pokémon. If you do, discard all Energy attached to those Pokémon that had any damage counters on them.

abilities.name: Exoskeleton
abilities.text: Any damage done to Donphan by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Rain Dance
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Water Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Water Pokémon. This power can't be used if Feraligatr is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hydro Crunch
attacks.text: Does 60 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.

abilities.name: Leaf Trans
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Grass Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. This power can't be used if Meganium is affected by a Special Condition.

abilities.name: Afterburner
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your discard pile for a Fire Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. If you do, put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon. This power can't be used if Typhlosion is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Flare Destroy
attacks.text: Discard an Energy card attached to Typhlosion and discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.name: Ho-Oh LEGEND
rules: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Ho-Oh LEGEND.

abilities.name: Sacred Rainbow
abilities.text: All Energy attached to Ho-Oh LEGEND are Fire Energy instead of their usual type.

attacks.name: Bright Wing
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to Ho-Oh LEGEND.

cards.flavorText: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent, seven-colored wings.

cards.name: Ho-Oh LEGEND
rules: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Ho-Oh LEGEND.

abilities.name: Sacred Rainbow
abilities.text: All Energy attached to Ho-Oh LEGEND are Fire Energy instead of their usual type.

attacks.name: Bright Wing
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to Ho-Oh LEGEND.

cards.flavorText: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent, seven-colored wings.

cards.name: Lugia LEGEND
rules: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Lugia LEGEND.

abilities.name: Ocean Grow
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Lugia LEGEND into play, you may look at the top 5 cards of your deck and attach all Energy cards you find there to Lugia LEGEND. Discard the other cards.

attacks.name: Elemental Blast
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy, Water Energy, and Lightning Energy attached to Lugia LEGEND.

cards.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

abilities.name: Ocean Grow
