cards.flavorText: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

cards.name: Cinccino

attacks.name: Tail Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Do the Wave
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the number of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

cards.name: Bouffalant

attacks.name: Double Stomp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

cards.name: Bouffalant

attacks.name: Revenge
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during his or her last turn, this attack does 70 more damage.

attacks.name: Head Charge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

cards.name: Energy Retrieval
rules: Put 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Energy Search
rules: Search your deck for a basic Energy card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Energy Switch
rules: Move a basic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Full Heal
rules: Remove all Special Conditions from your Active Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: PlusPower
rules: During this turn, your Pokémon's attacks do 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Poké Ball
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Pokédex
rules: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck and put them back on top of your deck in any order.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Pokémon Communication
rules: Reveal a Pokémon in your hand and put it on top of your deck. If you do, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Potion
rules: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Professor Juniper
rules: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Revive
rules: Put a Basic Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Super Scoop Up
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, put 1 of your Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your hand.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Switch
rules: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Reshiram

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: Does 10 more for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Blue Flare
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

cards.name: Zekrom

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Bolt Strike
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 40 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Energize
attacks.text: Attach a Lightning Energy from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This is an extremely rare Pikachu card. You're very lucky to have found it!

cards.name: Snivy

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

cards.name: Maractus

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pin Missile
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

cards.name: Tepig

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

cards.name: Oshawott

attacks.name: Water Pulse
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

cards.name: Alomomola
cards.flavorText: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

cards.name: Blitzle

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

cards.name: Munna

attacks.name: Yawn
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

cards.name: Sandile

attacks.name: Sand Tomb
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

cards.name: Zorua

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

cards.name: Klink

attacks.name: Charge Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, attach an Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

cards.name: Pidove

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

cards.name: Audino

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

cards.name: Pansage

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

cards.name: Simisage

attacks.name: Fire's Power
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Fire Energy attached to it, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

cards.name: Sewaddle

attacks.name: String Shot
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

cards.name: Swadloon

attacks.name: Double Razor Leaf
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

cards.name: Swadloon

attacks.name: Grass Cocooning
attacks.text: Heal 40 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

cards.name: Leavanny

attacks.name: Nurturing
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your Pokémon. Search your deck for a card that evolves from that Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon. (This counts as evolving that Pokémon.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: X-Scissor
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

cards.name: Leavanny

attacks.name: Triple Cutter
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 60 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

cards.name: Cottonee

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They go wherever the wind takes them. On rainy days, their bodies are heavier, so they take shelter beneath big trees.

cards.name: Cottonee

attacks.name: Cotton Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

cards.name: Whimsicott

attacks.name: Helping Hand
attacks.text: Search your deck for a basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Cotton Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

cards.name: Whimsicott

attacks.name: Encore
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can only use that attack.

attacks.name: U-turn
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Riding whirlwinds, they appear. These Pokémon sneak through gaps into houses and cause all sorts of mischief.

cards.name: Petilil

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

cards.name: Lilligant

attacks.name: Bemusing Aroma
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

cards.name: Deerling

attacks.name: Wild Kick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

cards.name: Sawsbuck

attacks.name: Push Down
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.

cards.name: Virizion

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sacred Sword
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Sacred Sword during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

cards.name: Pansear

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600º F.

cards.name: Simisear

attacks.name: Water's Power
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Water Energy attached to it, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

cards.name: Darumaka
cards.flavorText: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

cards.name: Darmanitan

attacks.name: Rock Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Fire Punch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: Its internal fire burns at 2,500º F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

cards.name: Panpour

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.

cards.name: Simipour

attacks.name: Grass' Power
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Grass Energy attached to it, heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rushing Water
attacks.text: Move an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

cards.name: Basculin

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Final Gambit
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, this Pokémon does 80 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

cards.name: Basculin

attacks.name: Splatter
attacks.text: Does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.

cards.name: Ducklett

attacks.name: Roost
attacks.text: Heal 40 damage from this Pokémon. This Pokémon can't retreat during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

cards.name: Swanna

attacks.name: Wing Dance
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It administers sharp, powerful pecks with its bill. It whips its long neck to deliver forceful repeated strikes.

cards.name: Cubchoo

attacks.name: Powder Snow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Rest
attacks.text: Heal 60 damage from this Pokémon. This Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

cards.name: Cubchoo
cards.flavorText: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

cards.name: Beartic

attacks.name: Sheer Cold
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Icicle Crash
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

cards.name: Beartic

attacks.name: Icy Wind
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Superpower
attacks.text: You may do 20 more damage. If you do, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

cards.name: Emolga

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Acrobatics
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membranes and released while it is gliding.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.flavorText: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

cards.name: Galvantula

attacks.name: Stun Needle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

cards.name: Thundurus

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Disaster Volt
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

cards.name: Woobat

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

cards.name: Swoobat

attacks.name: Phat Sound
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

cards.name: Venipede

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

cards.name: Whirlipede

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Steamroller
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

cards.name: Scolipede

attacks.name: Toxic Claws
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Wild Horn
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

cards.name: Sigilyph

attacks.name: Reflect
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 40 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Telekinesis
attacks.text: Does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

cards.flavorText: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

cards.name: Sigilyph

attacks.name: Quick Turn
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Psychic Assault
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

cards.name: Gothita

attacks.name: Hypnotic Gaze
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

cards.name: Gothita
cards.flavorText: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

cards.name: Gothorita

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

cards.name: Gothorita

attacks.name: Deleting Glare
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

cards.name: Gothitelle

abilities.name: Magic Room
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent can't play any Item cards from his or her hand.

attacks.name: Madkinesis
attacks.text: Does 20 more damage for each Psychic Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

cards.name: Gothitelle

attacks.name: Mental Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers' life spans.

cards.name: Roggenrola

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon would be damaged by an attack, prevent that attack's damage done to this Pokémon if that damage is 40 or less.

cards.flavorText: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

cards.name: Roggenrola

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.

cards.name: Boldore

attacks.name: Smack Down
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has Fighting Resistance, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

cards.name: Boldore

attacks.name: Hard Crash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage. If tails, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

cards.name: Gigalith

attacks.name: Shear
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. If any of those cards are Fighting Energy cards, attach them to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rock Bullet
attacks.text: Does 20 more damage for each Fighting Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.

cards.name: Drilbur

attacks.name: Hone Claws
attacks.text: During your next turn, each of this Pokémon's attacks does 30 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.flavorText: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

cards.name: Excadrill

attacks.name: Drill Run
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

cards.name: Excadrill

attacks.name: Dig
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

cards.name: Throh

attacks.name: Scarf Hold
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

cards.name: Sawk

attacks.name: Five Fierce Chops
attacks.text: Flip 5 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.flavorText: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

cards.name: Krokorok

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

cards.name: Krookodile

abilities.name: Black Eyes
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thrash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage. If tails, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

cards.name: Terrakion

attacks.name: Sacred Sword
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Sacred Sword during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

cards.name: Purrloin

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

cards.name: Liepard

attacks.name: Feint Attack
attacks.text: Does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Claw Rend
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

cards.name: Zorua

attacks.name: Rising Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

cards.name: Zoroark

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

cards.name: Vullaby

attacks.name: Rear Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.

cards.name: Mandibuzz

attacks.name: Bone Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Dark Pulse
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each Darkness Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.

cards.name: Ferroseed

attacks.name: Pin Missile
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: They stick their spikes into cave walls and absorb the minerals they find in the rock.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.flavorText: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

cards.name: Ferrothorn

attacks.name: Steel Feelers

cards.flavorText: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

cards.name: Ferrothorn

attacks.name: Iron Defense

attacks.name: Power Whip

cards.flavorText: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

cards.name: Klink

attacks.name: Gear Grind
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.

cards.name: Klang

attacks.name: Metal Sound
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Guard Press

cards.flavorText: Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

cards.name: Klinklang

attacks.name: Charge Beam
attacks.text: Attach an Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Zap Cannon
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon can't use Zap Cannon during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.

cards.name: Cobalion

attacks.name: Metal Horns
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sacred Sword
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Sacred Sword during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

cards.name: Patrat

attacks.name: Hyper Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.

cards.name: Watchog

attacks.name: Watcheck
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck and put them back on top of his or her deck in any order.

attacks.name: Quick Tail Smash
attacks.text: Before doing damage, you may flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.flavorText: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

cards.name: Tranquill

attacks.name: Claw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.

cards.name: Unfezant

attacks.name: Tailwind
attacks.text: Attach an Energy from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Feather Strike
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage. If tails, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves fell close to anyone other than their Trainers.

cards.name: Audino

attacks.name: Powerful Slap
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Heal Pulse
attacks.text: Heal 50 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has a radar-like ability to understand its surrounding through slight sounds.

cards.name: Minccino

attacks.name: Last Resort
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

cards.name: Cinccino

attacks.name: Captivate
attacks.text: Switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fluffy Tail
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

cards.name: Rufflet
cards.flavorText: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

cards.name: Rufflet

attacks.name: Claw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

cards.name: Braviary

attacks.name: Brave Bird
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.

cards.name: Tornadus

attacks.name: Energy Wheel
attacks.text: Move an Energy from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hurricane
attacks.text: Move a basic Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

cards.name: Bianca
rules: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Cheren
rules: Draw 3 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Crushing Hammer
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Great Ball
rules: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Pokémon you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Max Potion
rules: Heal all damage from 1 of your Pokémon. Then, discard all Energy attached to that Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Pokémon Catcher
rules: Switch your opponent's Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Recycle
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, put a card from your discard pile on top of your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Thundurus

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Disaster Volt
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

cards.name: Tornadus

attacks.name: Energy Wheel
attacks.text: Move an Energy from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hurricane
attacks.text: Move a basic Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

cards.name: Sewaddle

attacks.name: Leaf Boomerang
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

cards.name: Swadloon

attacks.name: String Shot
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

cards.name: Leavanny

abilities.name: Leaf Tailor
abilities.text: Each of your Pokémon that has any Energy attached to it has no Weakness.

attacks.name: Cutting Arm
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

cards.name: Petilil

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

cards.name: Lilligant

attacks.name: Aromax
attacks.text: Heal all damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Windmill
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

cards.name: Dwebble

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: The Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

cards.name: Crustle

attacks.name: X-Scissor
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 more damage.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

cards.name: Karrablast

attacks.name: Mysterious Evolution
attacks.text: If Shelmet is in play, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon. (This counts as evolving this Pokémon.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: When they feel threatened, they spit acidic liquid to drive attackers away. This Pokémon targets Shelmet.

cards.name: Foongus
cards.flavorText: For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.

cards.name: Amoonguss

attacks.name: Toxic
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

cards.name: Shelmet

attacks.name: Mysterious Evolution
attacks.text: If Karrablast is in play, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon. (This counts as evolving this Pokémon.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast. The reason is still unknown.

cards.name: Accelgor

attacks.name: Acid Spray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Slashing Strike
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Slashing Strike during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

cards.name: Virizion

attacks.name: Double Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Leaf Wallop
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Leaf Wallop attack does 40 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

cards.name: Victini

abilities.name: Victory Star
abilities.text: Once during your turn, after you flip any coins for an attack, you may ignore all effects of those coin flips and being flipping those coins again. You can't use more than 1 Victory Star Ability each turn.

attacks.name: Stored Power
attacks.text: Move all Energy attached to this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Victini

attacks.name: V-create
attacks.text: If you have 4 or fewer Benched Pokémon, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Pansear

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600° F.

cards.name: Simisear

attacks.name: Double Fire
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

cards.name: Heatmor

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Incinerate
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard a Pokémon Tool card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

cards.name: Larvesta

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

cards.name: Larvesta

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

cards.name: Volcarona

attacks.name: Fiery Dance
attacks.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Heat Wave
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.flavorText: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

cards.name: Palpitoad

attacks.name: Round
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the number of your Pokémon that have the Round attack.

cards.flavorText: It lives in water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

cards.name: Seismitoad

attacks.name: Round
attacks.text: Does 30 damage times the number of your Pokémon that have the Round attack.

cards.flavorText: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

cards.name: Tirtouga
rules: Put this card onto your Bench only with the effect of Cover Fossil
cards.flavorText: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

cards.name: Carracosta

abilities.name: Solid Rock
abilities.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, reduce that damage by 50 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

cards.name: Vanillite

attacks.name: Icicle Barb
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.

cards.name: Vanillish

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It conceals itself from enemy eyes by creating many small ice particles and hiding among them.

cards.name: Vanilluxe

attacks.name: Double Freeze
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads. If either of them is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.

cards.name: Frillish
cards.flavorText: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

cards.name: Jellicent

abilities.name: Cursed Body
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: Does 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The fate of ships and crew that wander into Jellicent's habitats: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.

cards.name: Cryogonal

attacks.name: Icy Wind
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Ice Shard
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Fighting Pokémon, this attack does 40 more damage.

cards.flavorText: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

cards.name: Cryogonal

attacks.name: Ice Chain
attacks.text: Switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Frost Vanish
attacks.text: You may return this Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

cards.flavorText: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

cards.name: Kyurem

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Glaciate
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It generates powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Blitzle

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

cards.name: Zebstrika

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Shock Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard all Lightning Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Emolga

attacks.name: Electrichain
attacks.text: Does 20 more damage if you have any Lightning Pokémon on your Bench.

cards.flavorText: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

cards.name: Tynamo

attacks.name: Thunder Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Eelektrik

abilities.name: Dynamotor
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

cards.name: Eelektross

attacks.name: Acid
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Wild Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

cards.name: Stunfisk

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

cards.name: Victini

attacks.name: V-blast
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

cards.name: Yamask

attacks.name: Perplex
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

cards.name: Yamask

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each retains memories of its former life.

cards.name: Cofagrigus

attacks.name: Damagriiigus
attacks.text: Move all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Perplex
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

cards.name: Cofagrigus

abilities.name: Durable Body
abilities.text: If this Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, this Pokémon is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP becomes 10 instead.

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

cards.name: Trubbish

attacks.name: Garbage Collection
attacks.text: Put a card from your discard pile on top of your deck.

cards.flavorText: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

cards.name: Garbodor

attacks.name: Gentle Wrap
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Gunk Shot
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: They absorb garbage and make it part of their bodies. They shoot poisonous liquid from their right-hand fingertips.

cards.name: Solosis
cards.flavorText: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

cards.name: Duosion
cards.flavorText: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

cards.name: Reuniclus

attacks.name: Future Sight
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck and put them back on top of your deck in any order.

attacks.name: Net Force
attacks.text: Does 40 damage times the number of Reuniclus you have in play.

cards.flavorText: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

cards.name: Reuniclus

attacks.name: Dizzy Punch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

cards.name: Elgyem

attacks.name: Calm Mind
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon had never been seen until it appeared from far in the desert 50 years ago.

cards.name: Elgyem

attacks.name: First Contact
attacks.text: Search your deck for 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

cards.name: Beheeyem

attacks.name: Synchronoise
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that shares a type with the Defending Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It uses psychic power to control an opponent's brain and tamper with its memories.

cards.name: Litwick

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel it burns.

cards.name: Litwick

attacks.name: Teleportation Burst
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leaches off the life force of any who follow it.

cards.name: Lampent

attacks.name: Luring Light
attacks.text: Switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

cards.name: Chandelure

abilities.name: Cursed Shadow
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Eerie Glow
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned and Confused.

cards.flavorText: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

cards.name: Gigalith

attacks.name: Core Cannon
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Fighting Energy attached to this Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

cards.name: Timburr

attacks.name: Pummel
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

cards.name: Gurdurr

attacks.name: Pummel
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

cards.name: Conkeldurr

abilities.name: Craftsmanship
abilities.text: This Pokémon gets +20 HP for each Fighting Energy attached to it.

attacks.name: Top Down
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

cards.flavorText: It it thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

cards.name: Conkeldurr

attacks.name: Chip Away
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Swing Around
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They know moves that enable them to swing the pillars freely in battle.

cards.name: Archen
rules: Put this card onto your Bench only with the effect of Plume Fossil

attacks.name: Acrobatics
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

cards.name: Archeops

abilities.name: Ancient Power
abilities.text: Each play can't play any Pokémon from his or her hand to evolve his or her Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rock Slide
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

cards.name: Stunfisk

attacks.name: Trickle
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a volt of electricity.

cards.name: Mienfoo
cards.flavorText: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attack. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

cards.name: Mienshao

attacks.name: Feint
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: It wield the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arms attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

cards.name: Golett

attacks.name: Dynamic Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization.

cards.name: Golurk

attacks.name: Hammer Arm

cards.name: Uxie

cards.name: Solosis

cards.name: Duosion

attacks.name: Focused Wish
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: When their two divided brains think the same thoughts, their psychic power is maximized.

cards.name: Reuniclus

cards.flavorText: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. They can crush boulders psychically.

cards.name: Golett

cards.name: Golurk

attacks.name: Iron Fist of Justice
attacks.text: If you have any Team Plasma Pokémon in play, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Shadow Punch

cards.name: Machop

cards.name: Machoke

attacks.name: Last-Chance Chop

cards.flavorText: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.

cards.name: Machamp

cards.flavorText: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.

cards.flavorText: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.

attacks.name: Kick of Righteousness
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Team Plasma Pokémon, this attack does 40 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.

attacks.name: Acrobatics

cards.name: Lairon

attacks.name: Iron Head
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

cards.name: Frogadier

attacks.name: Aqua Wave

cards.flavorText: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

cards.name: Greninja

attacks.name: Mat Block
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

cards.name: Clauncher
cards.flavorText: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.

cards.name: Poochyena
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

cards.name: Mightyena

attacks.name: Hard Bite
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.flavorText: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.flavorText: Blades comprise this Pokémon's entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

cards.name: Bisharp

attacks.name: Wicked Jab
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.

cards.name: Honedge

attacks.name: Continuous Slash
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.flavorText: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

cards.name: Granbull

attacks.name: Double Stomp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.

cards.name: Swirlix

attacks.name: Draining Kiss
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.flavorText: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

cards.name: Snorlax

attacks.name: Rock Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Miltank

attacks.name: Sitdown Splash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: If it is around babies, it milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

cards.name: Skitty

attacks.name: Jump On
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.flavorText: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.flavorText: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

cards.name: Fletchling

attacks.name: Razor Wind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

cards.name: Furfrou

attacks.name: Tight Jaw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Pokémon Catcher
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with his or her Active Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Potion
rules: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

rules: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Tierno
rules: Draw 3 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Venusaur-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Poison Powder
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Jungle Hammer
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.name: M Venusaur-EX
rules: Mega Evolution rule: When 1 of your Pokémon becomes a Mega Evolution Pokémon, your turn ends.
Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Crisis Vine
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

cards.name: Weedle

attacks.name: Leaf Munch
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Grass Pokémon, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Kakuna

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon would be damaged by an attack, prevent that attack's damage done to this Pokémon if that damage is 60 or less.

cards.flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

cards.name: Beedrill

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Flash Needle
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads. If all of them are heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

cards.name: Ledyba
cards.flavorText: When the weather turns cold, lots of Ledyba gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.

cards.name: Ledian

attacks.name: Mach Punch
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.

cards.name: Volbeat

attacks.name: Luring Glow
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Signal Beam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves Illumise's sweet aroma.

cards.name: Illumise

attacks.name: Pheromotion
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Grass Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its fragrance attracts a swarm of Volbeat, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.

cards.name: Pansage

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

cards.name: Simisage

attacks.name: Torment
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

cards.name: Chespin

attacks.name: Pin Missile
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

cards.name: Quilladin

attacks.name: Scrunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Wood Hammer
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators' attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.

cards.name: Chesnaught

abilities.name: Spiky Shield
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Touchdown
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

cards.name: Scatterbug
cards.flavorText: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

cards.name: Spewpa

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

cards.name: Vivillon

attacks.name: Conversion Powder
attacks.text: Choose either Asleep or Poisoned. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition.

attacks.name: Colorful Wind
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each different type of basic Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.

cards.name: Skiddo

attacks.name: Lead
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

cards.name: Gogoat

attacks.name: Lead
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Supporter cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Charge Dash
attacks.text: You may do 20 more damage. If you do, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being.

cards.name: Slugma

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

cards.name: Magcargo

attacks.name: Magma Mantle
attacks.text: You may discard the top card of your deck. If that card is a Fire Energy card, this attack does 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

cards.name: Pansear

attacks.name: Fireworks
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

cards.name: Simisear

attacks.name: Yawn
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Braixen

attacks.name: Clairvoyant Eye
attacks.text: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back on top of your deck in any order.

attacks.name: Fire Tail Slap
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

cards.name: Delphox

abilities.name: Mystical Fire
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Blaze Ball
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

cards.name: Fletchinder

attacks.name: Flame Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

cards.name: Talonflame

attacks.name: Devastating Wind
attacks.text: Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck and draws 4 cards.

attacks.name: Flare Blitz
attacks.text: Discard all Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.flavorText: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

cards.name: Cloyster

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and discard an Energy attached to that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spike Cannon
attacks.text: Flip 5 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

cards.name: Staryu

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long as the glowing central core remains intact.

cards.name: Starmie

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon and heal all damage from it.

attacks.name: Core Splash
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Psychic Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

cards.name: Lapras

attacks.name: Seafaring
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, attach a Water Energy card from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.

cards.name: Corsola

attacks.name: Refresh
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage and remove all Special Conditions from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spiny Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

cards.name: Panpour

attacks.name: Water Splash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

cards.name: Simipour

attacks.name: Recycle
attacks.text: Put a card from your discard pile on top of your deck.

cards.flavorText: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

cards.name: Froakie

attacks.name: Bounce
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

cards.name: Frogadier

attacks.name: Lick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

cards.name: Greninja
