abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Water Energy card from your hand. If you do, put 3 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mist Slash
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Nuzzle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

cards.name: Raichu

attacks.name: Circle Circuit
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the number of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

cards.name: Voltorb

abilities.name: Destiny Burst
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, put 5 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

cards.name: Electrode

attacks.name: Eerie Impulse
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

cards.name: Emolga-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Energy Glide
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward. If you attached Energy in this way, switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Electron Crush
attacks.text: You may discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.name: Ekans
cards.flavorText: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

cards.name: Arbok

attacks.name: Gastro Acid
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon has no Abilities until the end of your next turn.

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

cards.name: Spoink
cards.flavorText: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

cards.name: Grumpig

attacks.name: Tricky Steps
attacks.text: You may move an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes' minds.

cards.name: Venipede

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

cards.name: Whirlipede

attacks.name: Continuous Tumble
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

cards.name: Scolipede

attacks.name: Random Peck
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Poison Ring
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. That Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.

cards.name: Phantump

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into his or her deck.

cards.flavorText: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.

cards.name: Trevenant

abilities.name: Forest's Curse
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent can't play any Item cards from his or her hand.

attacks.name: Tree Slam
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.

cards.name: Pumpkaboo

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

cards.name: Gourgeist

attacks.name: Eerie Voice
attacks.text: Put 2 damage counters each of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spirit Scream
attacks.text: Put damage counters on both Active Pokémon until the remaining HP of each Pokémon is 10.

cards.flavorText: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

cards.name: Diglett

attacks.name: Mine
attacks.text: Look at the top card of your opponent's deck. Then, you may have your opponent shuffle his or her deck.

cards.flavorText: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

cards.name: Dugtrio

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Rock Tumble
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

cards.name: Rhyhorn

attacks.name: Dig Out
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your deck. If that card is a Fighting Energy, attach it to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

cards.name: Rhydon

attacks.name: Mad Mountain
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, discard the top card of your opponent's deck for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Rhyperior

attacks.name: Rock Black
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Fighting Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Rock Wrecker
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

cards.name: Lunatone

attacks.name: Double Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Moonblast
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

cards.name: Solrock

attacks.name: Cosmic Spin
attacks.text: If Lunatone is on your Bench, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

cards.name: Timburr

attacks.name: Pummel
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

cards.name: Gurdurr

attacks.name: Pummel
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Hammer Arm
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

cards.flavorText: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.

cards.name: Conkeldurr

attacks.name: Wake-Up Slap
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 60 more damage. Then, remove all Special Conditions from that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dynamic Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage and your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

cards.name: Sableye

attacks.name: Filch
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Rip Claw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.flavorText: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

cards.name: Krokorok

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

cards.name: Krookodile

attacks.name: Bother
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play any Supporter cards from his or her hand during his or her next turn.

attacks.name: Knock Back
attacks.text: Your opponent switches his or her Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.

cards.name: Zorua

attacks.name: Nasty Plot
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It changes so it looks like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

cards.name: Zoroark

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Flame Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Twin Bursts
attacks.text: If Electivire is on your Bench, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

cards.name: Torchic

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.

cards.name: Combusken

attacks.name: Midair Strike
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

cards.name: Blaziken

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Burning Shot
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 150 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It can clear a 30-story building in a leap. Its fiery punches scorch its foes.

cards.name: Poliwag

attacks.name: Spiral Current
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. That Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.

cards.name: Poliwhirl

attacks.name: Finishing Blow
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It can live in or out of water. When out of water, it constantly sweats to keep its body slimy.

cards.name: Poliwrath

attacks.name: Steamroll
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Submission
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.

cards.name: Politoed

abilities.name: King's Song
abilities.text: Ignore all Colorless Energy in the attack cost of each of your Poliwag, Poliwhirl, and Poliwrath's attacks.

cards.flavorText: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

cards.name: Glaceon

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Ice Edge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.

cards.name: Seismitoad-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Quaking Punch
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any Item cards from his or her hand during his or her next turn.

attacks.name: Grenade Hammer
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 2 of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Cubchoo

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

cards.name: Beartic

attacks.name: Igloo Hold
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Mountain Drop
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 40 more damage.

cards.flavorText: They love the cold seas of the north. They create pathways across the ocean waters by freezing their own breath.

cards.name: Clauncher

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.

cards.name: Clawitzer

attacks.name: Reverse Thrust
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Splash Cannon
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.

cards.name: Amaura
rules: Put this card onto your Bench only with the effect of Sail Fossil
cards.flavorText: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.

cards.name: Aurorus

abilities.name: Ice Shield
abilities.text: Any damage done by an opponent's attack to each of your Water Pokémon that has any Water Energy attached to it is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Icy Wind
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

cards.name: Raichu

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

cards.name: Electabuzz

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its body glows a whitish blue.

cards.name: Electivire

attacks.name: Tag Team Spark
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your Magmortar.

attacks.name: Gigavolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage. If tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

cards.name: Plusle

attacks.name: Positive Hand
attacks.text: Discard a basic Energy card from your hand. If you do, draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Electric Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

cards.name: Minun

attacks.name: Negative Discard
attacks.text: Put 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.flavorText: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

cards.name: Thundurus

attacks.name: Raging Thunder Punch
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Lightning Slam
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Lightning Slam during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

cards.name: Dedenne

attacks.name: Entrainment
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Energy Short
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

cards.name: Drowzee

attacks.name: Sinister Suggestion
attacks.text: Whenever your opponent flips a coin during his or her next turn, treat it as tails.

cards.flavorText: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating only bad dreams.

cards.name: Hypno

attacks.name: Hand Control
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals his or her hand. You may choose a Supporter card you find there. If you do, your opponent plays that Supporter card. However, you make all decisions for that card. (That Supporter card is discarded.)

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took away a child it hypnotized.

cards.name: Jynx

abilities.name: Victory Kiss
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may heal 10 damage from your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hug
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

cards.name: Skorupi

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

cards.name: Gothita

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

cards.name: Gothorita

attacks.name: Fortunate Eye
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck and put them back on top of his or her deck in any order.

cards.flavorText: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

cards.name: Gothitelle

abilities.name: Teleport Room
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard any Stadium card in play. If you do, put a Stadium card with a different name from your discard pile into play.

attacks.name: Psy Report
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals his or her hand.

cards.flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

cards.name: Golett

attacks.name: Rock Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

cards.name: Golurk

attacks.name: Wreck
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 60 more damage. Discard that Stadium card.

cards.flavorText: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

cards.name: Machop
cards.flavorText: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.flavorText: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

cards.name: Machamp

abilities.name: Fighting Fury
abilities.text: Each of your Fighting Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Machamp Crush
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 40 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

cards.name: Hitmonlee

attacks.name: Stretch Kick
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

cards.name: Hitmonchan

attacks.name: Bullet Punch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

cards.name: Hitmontop

attacks.name: Quick Draw
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Helicoptero
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by 10.

cards.name: Breloom

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sky Uppercut
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

cards.name: Makuhita
cards.flavorText: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

cards.name: Hariyama

abilities.name: Thick Fat
abilities.text: Any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Fire or Water Pokémon is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

cards.name: Trapinch

attacks.name: Mountain Munch
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

cards.flavorText: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.

cards.name: Lucario-EX

attacks.name: Missile Jab
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Corkscrew Smash
attacks.text: You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

cards.name: M Lucario-EX

cards.name: M Lucario-EX
rules: Mega Evolution rule: When 1 of your Pokémon becomes a Mega Evolution Pokémon, your turn ends.
Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Rising Fist
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Mienfoo

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.

cards.name: Mienshao

attacks.name: Aero Turn
attacks.text: Return this Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

cards.flavorText: It wields the fur on its arm like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

cards.name: Landorus

attacks.name: Shout of Power
attacks.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

cards.name: Pancham

attacks.name: Bad-Influence Evolution
attacks.text: If you have any Darkness Pokémon on your Bench, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon. (This counts as evolving this Pokémon.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

cards.name: Pancham

attacks.name: Comet Punch
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

cards.name: Tyrunt
rules: Put this card onto your Bench only with the effect of Jaw Fossil

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

cards.name: Tyrantrum

attacks.name: Chew Up
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has any Special Energy attached to it, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

cards.name: Hawlucha

abilities.name: Shining Spirit
abilities.text: Damage from this Pokémon's attacks isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Flying Press
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon isn't a Pokémon-EX, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

cards.name: Hawlucha-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Counterattack
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 2 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Moonsault Stomp
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 40 more damage.

cards.name: Drapion

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 40 more damage.

attacks.name: Venomous Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It takes great pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling it skin up to its neck.

cards.name: Scrafty

attacks.name: Machine Gun Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads. This Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

cards.name: Pangoro

attacks.name: Clobber
attacks.text: You may discard an Item card from your hand. If you do, this attack does 40 more damage.

attacks.name: Hammer Arm
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

cards.flavorText: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won't put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.

cards.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Moonlight
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

cards.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Moonblast
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

cards.name: Clefable

attacks.name: Follow Me
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Moonblast
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 30 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Its hearing is so acute it can hear a pin drop over half a mile away. It lives on quiet mountains.

cards.name: Sylveon

attacks.name: Curly Ribbon
attacks.text: Move an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Echoed Voice
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Echoed Voice attack does 50 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

cards.name: Klefki

abilities.name: Secret Key
abilities.text: Each of your Fairy Pokémon's Resistance is now -40.

attacks.name: Fairy Lock
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

cards.name: Dragonite-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Bust In
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may move any number of basic Energy attached to your Pokémon to this Pokémon. If you do, switch this Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Jet Sonic
attacks.text: You may discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 40 more damage.

cards.name: Vibrava

attacks.name: Charge Energy
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

cards.name: Flygon

attacks.name: Rainbow Shower
attacks.text: Attach as many basic Energy cards as you like from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Sand Sweep
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon that has any Energy attached to it.

cards.flavorText: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.

cards.name: Noivern

abilities.name: Echolocation
abilities.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

attacks.name: Boomburst
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

cards.name: Lickitung

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.

cards.name: Lickilicky

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Lickichop
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

cards.name: Eevee

abilities.name: Energy Evolution
abilities.text: When you attach a basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, you may search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon that is the same type as that Energy card and put it onto this Pokémon. (This counts as evolving this Pokémon.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.

cards.name: Slakoth

attacks.name: Big Yawn
attacks.text: Both Active Pokémon are now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

cards.name: Vigoroth

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Its heartbeat is fast and its blood so agitated that it can't sit still for one second.

cards.name: Slaking

attacks.name: Amnesia
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Knuckle Sandwich
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

cards.name: Patrat

attacks.name: Safety Check
attacks.text: Look at 1 of your face-down Prize cards.

cards.flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

cards.name: Watchog

attacks.name: Held-Item Inspection
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals his or her hand. Choose an Item card you find there. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck.

attacks.name: Thorough Crunch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

cards.name: Tornadus

attacks.name: Push Down
attacks.text: You may have your opponent switch his or her Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Twister Throw
attacks.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.flavorText: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

cards.name: Battle Reporter
rules: Draw cards until you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Energy Switch
rules: Move a basic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Fighting Stadium
rules: The attacks of each Fighting Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) do 20 more damage to the Defending Pokémon-EX (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

cards.name: Focus Sash
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.

If the Fighting Pokémon this card is attached to has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, that Pokémon is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP becomes 10 instead. Then, discard this card.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Fossil Researcher
rules: Search your deck for up to 2 in any combination of Amaura or Tyrunt and put them onto your bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Full Heal
rules: Remove all Special Conditions from your Active Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Jaw Fossil
rules: Look at the bottom 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Tyrunt you find there and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Korrina
rules: Search your deck for a Fighting Pokémon and an Item card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Maintenance
rules: Shuffle 2 cards from your hand into your deck. (If you can't shuffle 2 cards into your deck, you can't play this card.) Then, draw a card.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Mountain Ring
rules: Prevent all damage done to Benched Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).
This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

cards.name: Sail Fossil
rules: Look at the bottom 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal an Amaura you find there and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Sparkling Robe
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
The Pokémon this card is attached to can't be affected by any Special Conditions. (Remove any Special Conditions affecting that Pokémon.)
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Super Scoop Up
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, put 1 of your Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your hand.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Tool Retriever
rules: Choose up to 2 Pokémon Tool cards attached to your Pokémon and put them into your hand.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Training Center
rules: Each Stage 1 and Stage 2 Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) gets +30 HP.
This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

cards.name: Herbal Energy
rules: This card can only be attached to Grass Pokémon. This card provides Grass Energy only while this card is attached to a Grass Pokémon.
When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Grass Pokémon, heal 30 damage from that Pokémon.
(If this card is attached to anything other than a Grass Pokémon, discard this card.)

cards.name: Zigzagoon

attacks.name: Sand Attack
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

cards.name: Skitty

attacks.name: Charm
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

cards.name: Chikorita

attacks.name: Blot
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

cards.name: Bayleef

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

cards.name: Meganium

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.text: If this Pokémon's remaining HP is 50 or less, its attacks do 70 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Green Force
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

cards.name: Seedot
cards.flavorText: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

cards.name: Kricketot

attacks.name: Bug Hunch
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Grass Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

cards.name: Kricketune

attacks.name: Screech
attacks.text: During your next turn, any damage done to the Defending Pokémon by attacks is increased by 60 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.

cards.name: Petilil

attacks.name: Aromatherapy
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

cards.name: Lilligant

attacks.name: Boo-Hoo
attacks.text: If your opponent attaches an Energy card from his or her hand to the Defending Pokémon during his or her next turn, that Pokémon will be Asleep.

attacks.name: Leaf Slice
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

cards.name: Durant

attacks.name: Mountain Munch
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Scrape Down
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, discard the top 4 cards of your opponent's deck.

cards.flavorText: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

cards.name: Arcanine

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can't help but grovel before it.

cards.name: Numel
cards.flavorText: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

cards.name: Camerupt

attacks.name: Eruption
attacks.text: Each player discards the top card of his or her deck. This attack does 60 more damage for each Energy card discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

cards.name: Emboar-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Spiral Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Strong Flare
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Heatmor

attacks.name: Reinforced Flame
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: It has mystical powers but doesn't recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.

cards.name: Golduck

attacks.name: Derail
attacks.text: Discard a Special Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.

cards.name: Golduck BREAK
rules: BREAK Evolution Rule: Golduck BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

abilities.name: Hyper Transfer
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a basic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Slowpoke

attacks.name: Tail Lure
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

cards.name: Slowbro

attacks.name: Careless Head
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 more damage.

attacks.name: Walk-Off Homer
attacks.text: If you use this attack when you have only 1 Prize card left, you win this game.

cards.flavorText: When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.

cards.name: Slowking

abilities.name: Royal Flash
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psych Up
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Psych Up attack does 40 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke's head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

cards.name: Shellder

attacks.name: Razor Shell
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort.

cards.name: Shellder

attacks.name: Clamp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort.

cards.name: Cloyster

attacks.name: Sudden Grip
attacks.text: If this Pokémon evolved from Shellder during this turn, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

cards.name: Gyarados-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Stormy Seas
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, search your deck for a Water Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Splash Burn
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: M Gyarados-EX
rules: Mega Evolution rule: When 1 of your Pokémon becomes a Mega Evolution Pokémon, your turn ends.
Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Blast Geyser
attacks.text: You may do 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon. If you do, discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

cards.name: Lapras

attacks.name: Errand-Running
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Water Splash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its high intelligence enables it to understand human speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.

cards.name: Corsola

attacks.name: Spike Cannon
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: They prefer unpolluted southern seas. Their coral branches lose their color and deteriorate in dirty water.

cards.name: Suicune

abilities.name: Wind Charm
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, prevent all effects of your opponent's attacks, except damage, done to each of your Pokémon. (Existing effects are not removed.)

cards.flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

cards.name: Palkia-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Aqua Turbo
attacks.text: Search your deck for 2 Water Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Pearl Hurricane
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Manaphy-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Aqua Tube
abilities.text: Each of your Pokémon that has any Water Energy attached to it has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Mineral Pump
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from each of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Tympole

attacks.name: Round
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage times the number of your Pokémon in play that have the Round attack.

cards.flavorText: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

cards.name: Palpitoad

attacks.name: Frog Hop
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.

cards.name: Seismitoad

attacks.name: Siphon Off
attacks.text: Attach 3 Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Shaky Fall
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. That Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

cards.name: Ducklett

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

cards.name: Swanna

attacks.name: Brave Bird
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

cards.name: Froakie

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

cards.name: Frogadier

attacks.name: Water Duplicates
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Frogadier and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

cards.name: Greninja

attacks.name: Shadow Stitching
attacks.text: Until the end of your opponent's next turn, each Pokémon your opponent has in play, in his or her hand, and in his or her discard pile has no Abilities. (This includes cards that come into play on that turn.)

attacks.name: Moonlight Slash
attacks.text: You may return a Water Energy from this Pokémon to your hand. If you do, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

cards.name: Greninja BREAK
rules: BREAK Evolution Rule: Greninja BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

abilities.name: Giant Water Shuriken
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may discard a Water Energy card from your hand. If you do, put 6 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.flavorText: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

cards.name: Shinx

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent switches his or her Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Luxio

attacks.name: Thunder Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxray

attacks.name: Snarl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

cards.name: Luxray BREAK
rules: BREAK Evolution Rule: Luxray BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

attacks.name: Wild Fury
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 40 more damage for each heads.

cards.name: Blitzle

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

cards.name: Zebstrika

abilities.name: Zap Zone
abilities.text: Damage from the attacks of your Lightning Pokémon isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Crashing Bolt
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has Fighting Resistance, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Drowzee

attacks.name: Focused Wish
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: If you think that you had a good dream but you can't remember it, a Drowzee has probably eaten it.

cards.name: Hypno

abilities.name: Goodnight, Babies
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may leave both Active Pokémon Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.

cards.name: Espeon-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Miraculous Shine
attacks.text: Devolve each of your opponent's evolved Pokémon and put the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Psyshock
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Skorupi

attacks.name: Pin Missile
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

cards.name: Drapion

attacks.name: Poison Claws
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

cards.name: Sigilyph

attacks.name: Reflective Shield
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 5 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psy Report
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals his or her hand.

cards.flavorText: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.

cards.name: Trubbish

attacks.name: Acid Spray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

cards.name: Garbodor

abilities.name: Garbotoxin
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, each Pokémon in play, in each player's hand, and in each player's discard pile has no Abilities (except for Garbotoxin).

attacks.name: Offensive Bomb
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.flavorText: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.

cards.name: Meowstic

attacks.name: Energy Present
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Energy cards from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.

cards.name: Honedge

attacks.name: Stab
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

cards.name: Doublade

attacks.name: Stab Deeply
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

cards.name: Aegislash

attacks.name: Painful Sword
attacks.text: Double the number of damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Megaton Slash
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Apparently, it can detect innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

cards.name: Skrelp

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It looks just like rotten kelp. It hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution.

cards.name: Phantump

attacks.name: Ascension
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon. (This counts as evolving this Pokémon.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

cards.name: Trevenant

abilities.name: Nervous Seed
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Basic Pokémon's attacks cost Colorless more.

attacks.name: Energy Press
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It's kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

cards.name: Trevenant BREAK
rules: BREAK Evolution Rule: Trevenant BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

attacks.name: Silent Fear
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.name: Sudowoodo

attacks.name: Watch and Learn
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon used an attack during his or her last turn, use it as this attack.

cards.flavorText: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

cards.name: Gible

attacks.name: Never Enough
attacks.text: Discard a card from your hand. If you do, draw 2 cards.

cards.flavorText: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

cards.name: Gabite

attacks.name: Sand Tomb
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: As it digs to expand its nest, it habitually digs up gems that it then hoards in its nest.

cards.name: Garchomp

attacks.name: Turbo Assault
attacks.text: Attach an Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Bite Off
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon-EX, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It flies at speeds equals to a jet fighter plane. It never allows its prey to escape.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.flavorText: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can't help grinning if anyone pats its head.

cards.name: Nuzleaf

attacks.name: Razor Wind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

cards.name: Shiftry

attacks.name: Roll Up
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If any of them are heads, your opponent reveals his or her hand. Then, for each heads, discard a card from your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Otherworldly Return
attacks.text: Put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.flavorText: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 feet per second that can level houses.

cards.name: Darkrai-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Dark Pulse
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Darkness Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dark Head
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Asleep, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.name: Pangoro

attacks.name: Parting Shot
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 60 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Buster Swing
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: It charges ahead and bashes its opponents like a berserker, uncaring about any hits it might take. Its arms are mighty enough to snap a telephone pole.

cards.name: Scizor-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Steel Wing
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Gale Thrust
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was on the Bench and became your Active Pokémon this turn, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.name: M Scizor-EX
rules: Mega Evolution rule: When 1 of your Pokémon becomes a Mega Evolution Pokémon, your turn ends.
Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Iron Crusher
attacks.text: You may discard a Special Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon or a Stadium card in play.

cards.name: Mawile

attacks.name: Tight Jaw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

cards.name: Ferroseed

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon would be damaged by an attack, prevent that attack's damage done to this Pokémon if that damage is 60 or less.

cards.flavorText: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.

cards.name: Ferrothorn

attacks.name: Spike Lash
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon for each Colorless in that Pokémon's Retreat Cost. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

cards.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Sing
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

cards.name: Clefable

attacks.name: Moon Barrier
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by Dragon Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tumbling Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

cards.name: Togekiss-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Mighty Wind
attacks.text: You may attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hurricane Wing
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Spritzee
cards.flavorText: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked.

cards.name: Aromatisse

attacks.name: Dizzying Cologne
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon-EX, this attack does 40 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.

cards.name: Dragalge

attacks.name: Severe Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 4 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your deck.

cards.flavorText: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

cards.name: Rattata

attacks.name: Dangerous Suspicion
attacks.text: Draw a card. Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.

cards.name: Raticate

abilities.name: Antibodies
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't be affected by any Special Conditions. (Remove any Special Conditions affecting this Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Dirty Shock
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Discard all Pokémon Tool cards attached to that Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The webs on its hind legs enable it to cross rivers. It searches wide areas for food.

cards.name: Raticate BREAK
rules: BREAK Evolution Rule: Raticate BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

attacks.name: Super Fang
attacks.text: Put damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon until its remaining HP is 10.

cards.name: Dunsparce

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

cards.name: Stantler

attacks.name: Mystifying Horns
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Big Charge
attacks.text: If you have any Mega Evolution Pokémon on your Bench, this attack does 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

cards.name: Ho-Oh-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Purifying Fire
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon has any basic Fire Energy attached to it, you may heal 50 damage from it.

attacks.name: Elemental Feather
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon).

cards.name: Glameow

attacks.name: Act Cute
attacks.text: Your opponent puts a card from his or her hand on the bottom of his or her deck.

cards.flavorText: When it's happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

cards.flavorText: Dr.オーヤマ考案「日米交流カード」パーティ気分で和洋せっちゅう。

cards.name: Flying Pikachu

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: By learning how to fly, Pikachu overcame its weakness to Fighting Pokémon.

cards.name: Surfing Pikachu
cards.flavorText: One summer, a group of Pikachu was found riding the waves at the local beach.

cards.name: Imakuni?'s Doduo
rules: (This card cannot be used at official tournaments.)

abilities.name: Frenzied Escape
abilities.text: When this Doduo retreats, hold this card and throw it as hard as you can because Doduo is running away. Throw the card horizontally with a snap to get the farthest distance!

attacks.name: Harmonize
attacks.text: From the moment you use this attack, you must begin to sing a song. (While the song is being sung, the game continues.) When the song is finished, this attack does 30 damage.

cards.name: Here Comes Team Rocket!
rules: Each player turns all of his or her Prize cards face up. (Those Prize cards remain face up for the rest of the game.)
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Caterpie

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

cards.name: Metapod

attacks.name: Iron Defense
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn't move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.

cards.name: Butterfree

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: No matter how much it eats, the mushrooms growing on its back steal away most of the nutrients it consumes.

cards.name: Parasect

attacks.name: Fury Cutter
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If 1 of them is heads, this attack does 20 more damage. If 2 of them are heads, this attack does 60 more damage. If all of them are heads, this attack does 120 damage.

attacks.name: Mushroom Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The large mushroom on its back controls it. It often fights over territory with Shiinotic.

cards.name: Pinsir

attacks.name: Roof Fling
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put your opponent's Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: One solid blow from its horns is enough to split apart a large tree. Its greatest rival in Alola is Vikavolt.

cards.name: Surskit

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: When this Pokémon senses danger, a sweet fluid oozes from the tip of its heads. The taste of it disgusts bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Masquerain

attacks.name: Struggle Bug
attacks.text: Move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its wings and antennae don't cope well with moisture. After a rain, it faces sunward to dry off.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

cards.name: Dartrix

attacks.name: Sharp Blade Quill
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Leaf Blade
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

cards.name: Decidueye

attacks.name: Leaf Blade
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Brave Bird
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

cards.name: Grubbin
cards.flavorText: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Fomantis

attacks.name: Synthesis
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Grass Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: They give off a sweet and refreshing scent. Cutiefly often gather near the tall grass where Fomantis are hiding.

cards.name: Morelull

attacks.name: Flickering Spores
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

cards.name: Shiinotic

abilities.name: Illuminate
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Grass Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Flickering Spores
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

cards.name: Bounsweet

attacks.name: Sweet Scent
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.

cards.name: Steenee

attacks.name: Sweet Scent
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

cards.name: Tsareena

abilities.name: Queenly Majesty
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may have your opponent reveal their hand. Then, discard a card from it.

attacks.name: Trop Kick
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage and remove all Special Conditions from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

cards.name: Growlithe

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It's both clever and loyal, but if a stranger tries to invade its territory, it barks threateningly.

cards.name: Arcanine

attacks.name: Firestorm

cards.flavorText: Overflowing with beauty and majesty, this strong Pokémon appears in ancient Eastern folklore.

cards.name: Torkoal

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mounts where they live.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

cards.name: Torracat

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Darkest Lariat
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

attacks.name: Burning Slam-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Psyduck

attacks.name: Confusion Wave
attacks.text: Both Active Pokémon are now Confused.

cards.flavorText: As a result of headaches so fierce they cause it to cry, it sometimes uses psychokinesis without meaning to.

cards.name: Golduck

attacks.name: Double Jet
attacks.text: Discard up to 2 Water Energy cards from your hand. This attack does 60 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: It is said that the red part of its forehead grants supernatural powers to those who posses one, so it was over-hunted in the past.

cards.name: Poliwag

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage times the amount of Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It's still not very good at walking. Its Trainers should train this Pokémon to walk every day.

cards.name: Poliwhirl

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It marches over the land in search of bug Pokémon to eat. Then it takes them underwater so it can dine on them where it's safe.

cards.name: Poliwrath

attacks.name: Split Spiral Punch
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Wake-Up Slap
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 80 more damage. Then, remove all Special Conditions from that Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its percentage of body fat is nearly zero. Its body is entirely muscle, which makes it heavy and forces its swimming prowess to develop.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.flavorText: The hardness of its shell surpasses the hardness of a diamond. In days gone by, people used the shells to make shields.

cards.name: Cloyster

attacks.name: Headlock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage. If tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Its hard shell cannot be shattered—not even by a bomb. The contents of the shell remain unknown.
